summary: More community.postgresql 5.0.0 removals: the db and database aliases of login_db in postgresql_ping, privs, publication, query, schema, script and sequence, postgresql_sequence rename_to (use postgresql_query), and the postgresql_set module (use postgresql_alter_system).
questions: Why does postgresql_query reject the db option?

answer_card.title: postgresql_set was removed
answer_card.answer_md: In community.postgresql 5.0.0 (Ansible 15) `postgresql_set` is gone. Use `community.postgresql.postgresql_alter_system` to change server settings. Also replace any `db:` or `database:` option with `login_db:`.
